markScheme.exemplarAnswer: A grade 9 response will: describe the HRA mechanism (courts can declare incompatibility, public authorities must comply); argue it IS effective (rights enforceable domestically, courts have increased protection, landmark cases have improved rights); argue it is NOT fully effective (courts cannot strike down legislation, declarations of incompatibility are rare, government can ignore them, and proposed repeal threatens protections); conclude: the HRA provides significant but imperfect protection - its effectiveness depends on courts' willingness to make declarations and government's willingness to respond. A British Bill of Rights could strengthen protections but risks weakening them if it reduces international oversight.
